title: AI Optimism and the Agony of Waiting
source: The Psychology of Money with Morgan Housel
snippet: Most forecasts are hyper-optimistic or hyper-pessimistic. Not enough attention to the possibility that the main outcome in 10 years is that all businesses are 20%-30% more productive and life goes on.…
